purpose: Reference lab after food-r1 was rejected (F-2): the food map must look like a real map (Google Maps, or something cleaner).
method: Headless Chrome one-shot screenshots of public pages (Google and Apple render; MapLibre/Mapbox vector maps did not render headless except the Mapbox playground), Esri raster tiles stitched without a browser, OpenFreeMap's own sample image, Beli App Store screenshot.
